bass.tags: Indie rock with a driving, rhythmic focus. The track features a prominent, slightly overdriven electric bass playing a repetitive, syncopated eighth-note riff. A clean electric guitar provides rhythmic stabs and melodic counterpoint with a bright, jangly tone. The drum kit maintains a steady, mid-tempo groove with a crisp snare and tight hi-hat patterns. A subtle, warm synthesizer pad fills the mid-range frequencies in the background. The arrangement is centered around a 4/4 time signature at approximately 115 BPM in the key of A minor. The production is dry with minimal reverb, emphasizing the interlocking rhythmic layers of the bass and guitar.
bass.prompt:
[Instrumental]

[Intro]
[syncopated overdriven electric bass riff enters]
[tight hi-hat and kick drum pattern]

[Section A]
[clean electric guitar enters with rhythmic stabs]
[snare drum joins the groove]

[Section B]
[warm synthesizer pad swells in the background]
[guitar transitions to a melodic lead line]

[Outro]
[drums and synth drop out]
[bass riff fades out with final guitar chord]

drums.tags: Industrial techno with heavy EBM influences. The track is built around a distorted, saturated kick drum that provides a rhythmic pulse at 130 BPM in the key of D minor. A metallic, percussive synth sequence with a short decay and high-pass filtering creates a syncopated 16th-note pattern. A resonant, acid-style bassline enters with a low-pass filter sweep, utilizing a sawtooth waveform with high resonance. Industrial foley sounds, including metallic clangs and mechanical whirs, are processed with heavy plate reverb and rhythmic gating. A dark, cinematic drone pad provides a harmonic bed in the lower-mid frequencies. The percussion features a sharp, white-noise snare on the backbeat and closed hi-hats playing straight eighth notes with slight velocity randomization.
drums.prompt:
[Instrumental]

[Intro]
[distorted kick drum enters, four-on-the-floor]
[metallic percussive synth sequence starts]

[Section A]
[resonant sawtooth bassline enters with filter sweep]
[closed hi-hats playing eighth notes]

[Section B]
[white-noise snare on beats 2 and 4]
[industrial metallic clangs with plate reverb]
[low-mid drone pad enters]

[Breakdown]
[kick drum drops out]
[filtered synth sequence remains with rising resonance]
[mechanical whirring foley sounds]

[Outro]
[kick drum re-enters]
[instruments gradually fade out via low-pass filter]
